care.summary: Evergreen kitchen allium for tropical and subtropical gardens; cut-and-come-again scallions.
care.water: Keep evenly moist; do not let pots bone-dry
care.soil: Fertile, well-draining bed or container mix
care.fertilizer: Light nitrogen feed after each heavy harvest
care.toxicity: Edible; generally safe in culinary amounts
tips: Cut above white base to regrow
Great edge plant in subtropical kitchen gardens
care.climate_notes: Reliable outdoor perennial in mild subtropical winters; mulch in cooler snaps.
